note: Entity Browser Vertical adds one Entity Browser field-widget-display plugin, entity_browser_vertical_label ('Entity label, stacked vertically'), that subclasses EntityLabel. It only matters on an entity-reference field whose form-display widget is entity_browser_entity_reference: when that widget's settings.field_widget_display equals entity_browser_vertical_label, hook_field_widget_complete_entity_browser_entity_reference_form_alter() adds the entity-browser-vertical CSS class, injects tabledrag handles, and attaches the module CSS. Depends on entity_browser. Easy cases are grounded in the plugin id, the alter hook, and the CSS class. Medium/hard cases create an entity_reference field on Article using the Entity Browser widget and set/read the field_widget_display value. SMOKE-TEST STATUS: the medium/hard scripts create field storage, which was NOT possible on the shared eval site at authoring time because a pre-existing broken commerce_giftcard entity state makes every route rebuild (triggered by field-storage creation) fatal; consequently the medium/hard cases here were NOT smoke-tested. The scripts follow the proven field-creation + form-display pattern and are expected to pass once field-storage creation works again. Easy cases require no site changes.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module entity_browser_vertical makes Entity Browser selections stack vertically. What display plugin does it add, and how do you select it on an entity-reference field?
evals.expected_output: It adds an Entity Browser FieldWidgetDisplay plugin with id entity_browser_vertical_label ('Entity label, stacked vertically'). On the field's Entity Browser widget in Manage form display, set the display plugin (field_widget_display) to it.

evals.prompt: How does entity_browser_vertical actually make the selected items stack vertically instead of side by side? Name the CSS class it adds.
evals.expected_output: hook_field_widget_complete_entity_browser_entity_reference_form_alter() checks the widget's field_widget_display; when it is entity_browser_vertical_label it adds the CSS class 'entity-browser-vertical' to the current-selection container, injects tabledrag-handle links, and attaches the module's CSS library.

evals.prompt: What module does entity_browser_vertical depend on, and what base plugin class does its display plugin extend?
evals.expected_output: It depends on the entity_browser module, and its plugin EntityBrowserVerticalEntityLabel is an (empty) subclass of Entity Browser's EntityLabel display plugin.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity-reference field whose Entity Browser widget is set to display its selection stacked vertically (entity_browser_vertical). Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_ebv_known: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its entity_browser_entity_reference widget has settings.field_widget_display = entity_browser_vertical_label.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two Entity Browser reference fields, field_ebv_on and field_ebv_off. Exactly one displays its selection stacked vertically via entity_browser_vertical. Inspect the live form-display configuration and state which field uses the vertical display.
evals.expected_output: field_ebv_on uses the vertical display: its entity_browser_entity_reference widget has settings.field_widget_display = entity_browser_vertical_label, whereas field_ebv_off uses the plain 'label' display.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity-reference field field_ebv_task whose default form-display widget is the Entity Browser widget (entity_browser_entity_reference). Using the entity_browser_vertical module, configure that widget to display the current selection stacked vertically. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_ebv_task component (widget entity_browser_entity_reference) has settings.field_widget_display = entity_browser_vertical_label.

evals.prompt: On my Article edit form, the media I pick with the media/entity browser shows up in a horizontal row that overflows. I want the selected items listed vertically, one per line, so I can reorder them. The field is field_ebv_gallery. Please set that up.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_ebv_gallery component (widget entity_browser_entity_reference) has settings.field_widget_display = entity_browser_vertical_label.
